titulo.alumno: Novice · Greetings and polite phrases: Listening comprehension

intro: T1 · Beginner · Recognise letters, vocabulary and common phrases; understand basic grammar structures and short sentences from everyday life. Topic: Greetings and polite phrases. Focus: Listening comprehension (optional).

palabras.consejo: Practise the word within a sentence and pay attention to the tone.

texto: Listening in real time: when you hear Thai speakers at natural speed, the particle «ครับ» often sounds like a quick, clipped [khráp] or [kháp], while «ค่ะ» sounds short with a falling intonation [khâ] in statements and «คะ» [khá] in questions. Paying attention to these final particles helps you recognise politeness patterns, the social tone of the exchange and the usual conventions between speakers, without reducing the analysis to rigid stereotypes.
